title.zh: Crypto PAC spends $11M to oppose Sherrod Brown in Ohio
title.en: Crypto PAC spends $11M to oppose Sherrod Brown in Ohio

current_state.zh: The crypto-aligned Defend American Jobs PAC, affiliated with Fairshake, reported spending $11.4 million on ads backing Republican Jon Husted and opposing Democrat Sherrod Brown in Ohio's US Senate race, part of an initial $30 million pledge in the state.
current_state.en: The crypto-aligned Defend American Jobs PAC, affiliated with Fairshake, reported spending $11.4 million on ads backing Republican Jon Husted and opposing Democrat Sherrod Brown in Ohio's US Senate race, part of an initial $30 million pledge in the state.
